title: Almond milk, unsweetened, plain, shelf stable

content.title: About
content.content: Almond milk is a plant‑based beverage made by blending almonds with water and straining the mixture. The unsweetened version has a neutral, slightly nutty flavor and is suitable for those watching sugar intake. Shelf‑stable packaging allows it to be stored at room temperature until opened.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Almond milk is a popular dairy alternative in vegan diets.
Unsweetened varieties contain far fewer calories than sweetened ones.
UHT processing and aseptic cartons keep the product fresh without refrigeration before opening.
It is naturally rich in vitamin E and plant sterols that may support cholesterol balance.
Unlike soy milk, almond milk is free of lactose and gluten.

items.title: Rich in vitamin E
items.content: Vitamin E is a potent antioxidant that helps protect cells from oxidative damage.

items.title: Low calorie content
items.content: Unsweetened almond milk provides about 30 kcal per 100 ml, making it suitable for calorie‑controlled diets.

items.title: Source of plant sterols
items.content: Sterols may help lower LDL (bad) cholesterol levels.

items.title: Lactose‑free
items.content: Ideal for people with lactose intolerance and for vegans.

items.title: Fortified with calcium and vitamin D
Tree nut allergy
items.content: Individuals allergic to almonds may experience mild to severe reactions, including anaphylaxis.

items.title: Low protein content
items.content: Compared with cow’s milk, almond milk provides much less protein, so it may not meet high‑protein dietary needs.

items.title: Added sugars in flavored versions
items.content: Be sure to choose the unsweetened product to avoid unnecessary sugar intake.

items.title: Oxalate content
items.content: Almonds contain oxalates; people prone to kidney stones should consume the drink in moderation.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Drink it plain, add to smoothies, oatmeal, coffee, baked goods, or sauces. It can also replace dairy milk in baby foods for those who need a non‑dairy option.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep unopened cartons in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, refrigerate and consume within 7‑10 days. Discard if it develops a sour smell or off‑taste.
